brand.name: Casa de Garcia
brand.description: Not on the site at all - confirmed absent from the site's full brand index. Discovered on the Mac during the Altadis USA reorganization: photos were misfiled under three wrongly-named Altadis USA subfolders ('Flor de Selva Maduro,' 'Joya de Nicaragua Red,' 'La Aroma de Cuba Connecticut') and have been consolidated into a correct, new top-level 'Casa de Garcia' folder. A budget/bundle-tier cigar brand distributed by Altadis USA, sold largely in bundles at roughly $1-2/stick, made at the same factories that produce Montecristo, Romeo y Julieta, and Saint Luis Rey. Founding year is UNVERIFIED - not found in any source checked (including Wikipedia's list of cigar brands, which does not list this brand at all) - trade-press coverage is essentially nonexistent, consistent with its budget tier. IMPORTANT CORRECTION: contrary to an initial assumption of Honduran manufacture, no source found supports Honduras as the factory location - the core 4 wrapper-variant lines are made in the Dominican Republic and the 2 Centenario lines in Nicaragua (Plasencia family, Esteli). Honduran-grown filler tobacco appears in several blends, which may be the source of the Honduras assumption, but it is not the factory/origin country.
brand.founded_note: Not found in any source checked - recorded as unknown rather than guessed.
brand.origin_country: Dominican Republic (Connecticut, Maduro, Sumatra, Nicaragua-blend lines); Nicaragua (Centenario Red/Gold lines, made by the Plasencia family in Esteli)

line.name: Casa de Garcia Connecticut
line.description: A wrapper variant of the core Casa de Garcia blend (not a separately-blended sub-line).
